title: usage.v1
description: The source-agnostic usage-event ingest contract for platform-billing-operator. Every collector (MaaS capture filter, future upstream structured logs, GPUaaS Kueue collector) emits this envelope; ledger-svc upserts idempotently on record_id. Product-specific detail lives ONLY in quantities keys and sku — the billing core never interprets them beyond the PriceBook. This file is the interface named in operator-plan/README.md principle 6 and architecture.md §3; breaking changes require a new schema_version (usage.v2), never mutation.

schema_version.description: Envelope version. Consumers MUST reject unknown versions rather than guess.

record_id.description: Idempotency key. MaaS: the gateway request_id. GPUaaS: allocation-interval id (workload UID + interval seq). Ledger upserts on this; conflicting content for the same record_id goes to the DLQ, never overwrites.

occurred_at.description: Event completion time, RFC 3339, UTC. For streaming: time of stream termination. For GPUaaS interval events: interval end.

tenant_id.description: Billing tenant identity as resolved by the platform (Authorino filter metadata for MaaS; queue/namespace mapping for GPUaaS). NEVER sourced from client-supplied headers.

key_id.description: API key identifier (not the secret) for per-key attribution and BudgetPolicy grouping. MaaS only; absent for GPUaaS.

profile.description: Metering profile that produced the event (ADR-0005).

collector.description: Concrete collector implementation, e.g. 'capture-wasm', 'capture-extproc', 'kuadrant-structured-logs', 'kueue-collector'. Lets the reconciler and DLQ triage distinguish sources after a MeteringPipeline.spec.source switch.

collector_version.description: Collector build version, for forensic replay.

sku.description: What was consumed, in PriceBook terms. MaaS: model identifier (e.g. 'llama-3-70b'). GPUaaS: flavor (e.g. 'h200', 'h200-mig-3g.40gb').

geo.description: Geography tag for per-geo rates and data-residency partitioning (Q8). Optional; PriceBook default-geo rates apply when absent.

quantities.description: Profile-specific measured quantities. Keys are rated against PriceBook component rates; unknown keys are preserved in the ledger (forward-compat: new token types land here first — gap-analysis §4) but produce a 'unrated_quantity' warning until priced.

reasoning_tokens.description: From completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens when the engine emits it; otherwise absent (billed per PriceBook fallback rule).

status.description: Terminal request status. client_disconnect: partial usage recorded; billable per the disclosed policy (Q6). upstream_error: provider fault (e.g. 5xx mid-stream, no usage chunk); rated $0 by default (Q15) and routed via DLQ when quantities are absent or partial.

partial.description: True when quantities are best-effort (disconnect/error before the usage-bearing chunk). Partial events participate in reconciliation but are flagged in rating.

stream.description: MaaS: whether the request was a streaming response. Affects capture path and reconciliation slicing.

latency_ms.description: MaaS: request wall time. Display/SLO only — never rated.

interval.description: GPUaaS: the allocation interval this event covers (hourly interval events keep wallets draining continuously).

attributes.description: Free-form pass-through attribution metadata (project, cost_center, workload labels). Bounded: values are strings, and collectors MUST NOT put secrets or request/response content here.
